story: Sophie is in the classroom. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie and her friend Ruby are making a big, red crown. The crown is on the table. Sophie is cutting and Ruby is gluing. [emotion:QT/surprised] Oh no! The crown falls under the chair! [emotion:QT/sad] Sophie and Ruby cannot reach it. Sophie asks the teacher for help. The teacher picks up the crown. [emotion:QT/happy] Now the crown is back on the table. Sophie and Ruby put three shiny stars on the crown. The crown is beautiful! [emotion:QT/happy]
